correctness.rationale: All 32768 subsets have been independently tested against equivalent membership predicates. The 405 nonempty faces admit 185 explicitly identified acyclic matching pairs and precisely one 0-cell, 24 2-cells and 10 3-cells, with every one of 1155 cover arrows checked. Exact signed integer gradient elimination gives the identically zero 24-by-10 Morse boundary. A no-one-cell CW model has simply connected 2-skeleton; Hurewicz identifies every 3-cell attaching homotopy class with its integer degree vector, proving all attach trivially. Direct mod-2 boundary ranks (14,91,80) independently corroborate 24 and 10 Betti numbers; finite checks are exhaustive only for this graph.

value.rationale: The canonical triangular graph L(K6) is a smallest geometrically natural example permitting both maximal perfect-matchings and two disjoint length-two paths under the induced-component size bound. Their coexistence creates a nonpure complex with simultaneous exact integral homotopy in dimensions 2 and 3. The theorem completely resolves a natural previously unclassified graph complex, beyond known matching or clique homology, with potential comparative value for higher-independence topology; it is neither a trivial relabeling nor an extrapolation from finite experiments.
